title: Chinese Remainder Theorem for RSA correctness
statement: Let $p$, $q$, $m$, and $ed$ be natural numbers with $p$ and $q$ coprime, and suppose that $m^{ed} \equiv m \pmod{p}$ and $m^{ed} \equiv m \pmod{q}$. Then $m^{ed} \equiv m \pmod{pq}$.
replaced:
Let $p$ and $q$ be coprime and suppose $m^{ed} \equiv m$ both in $\bbz/p\bbz$ and in
$\bbz/q\bbz$. Then $m^{ed} \equiv m$ in $\bbz/pq\bbz$.
